svg.title: ETHOS — Reliable repository evolution
svg.desc: Terminal product vision, not a release claim. People and interchangeable Agents research and align intent, compile and compose capabilities, collaborate and explore, verify and deliver, observe and learn, recover and continue. CLI, SDK, MCP and Skills share meaning.

g.text: TERMINAL PRODUCT VISION
问道
ETHOS
Reliable repository evolution.
From a real problem to verified change — and observed benefit.
For people and interchangeable Agents. One coherent product, not more governance.
THE COMPLETE PRODUCT PATH
Research & align
Observe the problem. Challenge interpretations.
Preserve constraints, trade-offs and accepted intent.
Compile & compose
Turn meaning into bounded obligations.
Select replaceable Skills, generators and tools.
Collaborate & explore
Combine contributions. Compete or decline all.
Preserve useful results before controlled retirement.
Verify & deliver
Recheck authority and facts at each effect.
Accept exact candidates; deliver to each target.
Observe & learn
Distinguish deployment from actual benefit.
Feed grounded observations into new intent.
Recover & continue
Resume through interruptions and handoffs.
Form, adopt, upgrade and exit without loss.
A SMALL TRUST KERNEL — NOT A SMALL PRODUCT
Accepted intent → bounded effects → observed results
Compilation is transient. Admission is fresh at every effect.
OpenSpec owns accepted intent. Attestation records results, not authority.
No diagram, signature, green check or cached result grants permission.
CLI · SDK · MCP · SKILLS
One application meaning. Discoverable context. Actionable recovery.
Product supply, repository selection and project tools remain distinct.
TARGET DELIVERY
Homebrew · Native macOS + Linux · Windows when qualified
Design intent, not a claim of shipped capabilities or platform acceptance.
ETHOS / 问道
